title: Improved Models for Media Bias Detection and Subcategorization

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot and fine-tuned large language models (GPT-3.5, GPT-4) on their ability to detect, rate the strength of, and sub-categorize biased sentences in news articles into 27 granular bias types using the BABE and BASIL datasets.
Measuring the models' ability to classify text exhibiting inclination towards a specific political party, ideology, or candidate as a specific sub-category of news media bias.

Evaluating models on identifying news sentences that promote stereotypes, prejudice, or unequal representation based on demographic factors like ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, or religious beliefs.
